answer_1.quote: We investigate three exemplar applications, including basic language modeling, domain adaptation, and generating citations for question answering.
answer_1.outputs: generated texts with dynamic vocabulary for language modeling, domain adaptation, and citation generation

answer_2.quote: We use four automatic evaluation metrics to measure the quality of the generated texts: (i) MAUVE, (ii) Rep-n, (iii) Diversity, and (iv) Perplexity.

answer_3.quote: We also employ GPT-4 (Achiam et al., 2023) for further assessment.
methods: interleaving order to mitigate positional bias

answer_4.quote: To gain further assessment, we also run human evaluation on a random sample of 100 generations. For each test sample prefix, the annotators are given two continuations generated by the baseline and our model respectively in random order.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are asked to choose which one is better (in terms of fluency, coherence, informativeness, and grammar). When annotators make different decisions on the same sample, they will discuss and make the final decision.
